sections.heading: Shridevi Institute of Paramedical Science Fees Structure 2025

content.text: The Shridevi Institute of Paramedical Science fees and reviews 2025 show that the college provides affordable education with high standards. The course-wise annual and total fees are listed below for the 2025 admission session:

items: B.Sc. Cardiac Care costs Four Lakhs for the first year, followed by Two Lakhs each for the second and third years, totaling Eight Lakhs.
B.Sc. Perfusion Technology is priced at Three Lakhs Twenty-Five Thousand in the first year and One Lakh Twenty-Five Thousand for the next two years, totaling Five Lakhs Seventy-Five Thousand.

B.Sc. Radiology (MIT) and B.Sc. Anesthesia & OT have the same structure—Two Lakhs Seventy-Five Thousand in the first year and One Lakh Twenty-Five Thousand for the following years, totaling Five Lakhs Twenty-Five Thousand.
Courses like Respiratory Care, Neurology, and Optometry are offered at Two Lakhs in the first year and Eighty Thousand annually after that, totaling Three Lakhs Sixty Thousand.

Medical Lab Technology, Emergency Medicine, and Hospital Administration cost Two Lakhs for the first year and Seventy-Five Thousand for the second and third years, summing up to Three Lakhs Fifty Thousand.

sections.heading: Shridevi Institute of Paramedical Science Reviews
Faculty

content.text: The faculty at Shridevi Institute are highly qualified professionals with experience in both academics and healthcare practice. Students frequently commend the teachers for being supportive, approachable, and dedicated to real-world training. Departments such as Cardiac Care, Medical Imaging, and OT have specialized instructors with clinical exposure.

sections.heading: Clinical Exposure & Internship

content.text: Shridevi Institute has its own multi-specialty hospital, which is a major advantage for hands-on training. Clinical exposure starts in the second year for most courses. Students are placed in real-time departments such as ICU, Radiology, OT, and Emergency Medicine. Internships are mandatory and provided in the final year within the hospital or affiliated healthcare centers.

sections.heading: Placements

content.text: According to Shridevi Institute of Paramedical Science reviews 2025, placements are robust. Top recruiters include Fortis, Apollo, Manipal Hospitals, and Columbia Asia. Courses like Radiology, Cardiac Care, and Perfusion Technology see the highest placement rates. Students have secured jobs with salaries ranging from ₹2.5 to ₹8 LPA, depending on the specialization and experience.

sections.heading: Infrastructure

items: Modern labs for each department: Radiology, Cardiac Care, and OT
Smart classrooms, simulation labs, and digital library
Separate hostel facilities for boys and girls

sections.heading: Campus Life

content.text: Students participate in cultural programs, sports meets, and workshops regularly. The college conducts frequent healthcare awareness camps, skill development sessions, and interdisciplinary seminars. A balance of academics and extracurriculars makes for a vibrant campus environment.

sections.heading: Affordability & Financial Support

content.text: When it comes to affordability, the Shridevi Institute of Paramedical Science fees and reviews 2025 reflect that the institution offers value-based education. Fee payment can be made in easy installments, and scholarships are available for Merit-based performance, students from economically weaker sections, SC/ST/OBC and minority communities.

sections.heading: Conclusion

content.text: If you are looking for an institution that offers recognized degrees, affordable fee structure, quality infrastructure, clinical training, and high placement rates, then Shridevi Institute is the right choice. The Shridevi Institute of Paramedical Science fees and reviews 2025 prove that it is one of the best paramedical colleges in Karnataka. Seats are filling fast due to high demand. sections.heading: Is Shridevi Institute affiliated with RGUHS?

content.text: Yes, Shridevi Institute of Paramedical Science is affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS), Bangalore.

sections.heading: Does the college provide internship and clinical training?

content.text: Yes, the institute offers mandatory clinical training and internships within its own hospital and partner healthcare institutions.

sections.heading: Are hostel facilities available at Shridevi Institute?

content.text: Yes, separate hostels are available for boys and girls with food, security, and other essential amenities.
